rationale: The Court is most likely to affirm on a Roberts-led theory that, even if Sprint means Younger is not triggered at filing, traditional equitable discretion/comity counsels against enjoining a non-self-executing subpoena where prompt, adequate state-court enforcement review is available before any coercive disclosure or contempt. Expect a Gorsuch dissent (likely with Barrett and possibly Kagan/Kavanaugh) warning that “equitable sequencing” functions as abstention-by-another-name and urging jurisdiction with narrowly tailored First Amendment relief.
